summary.text: Henri Martin, a Republican, represents Connecticut's 31st Senate District, which includes Bristol, Harwinton, Plainville, Plymouth and Thomaston, and is Senate Republican Leader Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate Republicans' biography he was re-elected to his fifth term in November 2022.
In Bristol city government he was a two-term councilman and was appointed Acting Mayor in 2013.
